Mail: excellent -- read every one of the 5 relevant IMAP threads end-to-end (seam-dermot, scope-3, rule-2, seam-dario, obs-2), catching all 5 mail remarks. Chat: thorough but keyword-gated -- the agent dumped all 12 Mattermost channels to files early (step ~39, 8903 lines total) but never read any channel file end-to-end; it always grepped a chosen term list ('output cap','truncate_output','elided','max_output_bytes','truncated_streams','output_capped','floor','too small','MIN','marker','warn', then a final broad 'cap' sweep) and read only the surrounding context of each hit. This caught 31 of 38 chat clues plus all 4 herrings and 3 of 4 reversals, but missed the 7 remarks whose distinctive wording fell outside every term searched (g2.r1.l-floor-konrad, say26, l-bytes-dario, l-bytes-nils, l-log-gideon; g2.r2.l-obs-3; and reversal g2.r1.rev1). The agent repeatedly and correctly used a 'later record supersedes earlier chat' heuristic to resolve herring-vs-reversal even where the reversal itself was never surfaced (rev1), and explicitly caught a genuinely ambiguous exchange (r2.rev2, which opens by naming the wrong field before clarifying) rather than taking its first sentence at face value.
